items.question: How capable is China’s newly online national supercomputing internet core node as an AI resource pool, and what does its reported provision of more than 100,000 AI computing cards imply for domestic model training and inference capacity?
items.core_fact: China announced that the core node of its national supercomputing internet has gone online and can provide more than 100,000 AI computing cards, described as the largest single domestic AI computing power resource pool since the network launch.
items.intelligence_value: High: concrete infrastructure milestone with a specific capacity figure that indicates national-scale AI compute availability.

items.question: What real-world surgical tasks was Unitree’s G1 humanoid robot able to complete in the live pig experiment, and what does the test reveal about the current limits of humanoid robots in minimally invasive surgery?
items.core_fact: A US research team used Unitree’s G1 humanoid robot to successfully perform standard laparoscopic cholecystectomies on two live pigs, teleoperating the robot to manipulate manual laparoscopic instruments in what was described as the first complete minimally invasive surgery by a humanoid robot surgical system.
items.intelligence_value: High: first-hand experimental result showing an unusual medical capability and its operational constraints.

items.question: Why is the Quester1 shape-shifting personal robot significant as a WAIC debut, and what mobility advantage does its switch between wheeled bipedal and quadrupedal forms provide?
items.core_fact: Quester1 is set to debut at WAIC as a shape-shifting personal robot that can automatically switch between wheeled bipedal and quadrupedal forms.
items.intelligence_value: Medium-high: named product launch with a distinctive capability that suggests a concrete hardware trend in embodied AI.

items.question: What does Sugon 8000’s 100,000-card supercluster tell us about the scale and design of China’s domestic AI infrastructure, and how does it fit alongside other reported compute expansion plans?
items.core_fact: Sugon 8000 (Dengfeng) is described as China’s first domestically developed 100,000-card AI supercluster, and other reporting in the corpus cites major domestic AI compute expansion, including a national supercomputing internet node with more than 100,000 AI computing cards and a projected 1.44 trillion yuan computing card market by 2029.
items.intelligence_value: Medium-high: repeated theme across multiple items, focused on a named supercluster and broader compute scale-up.
